input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Deepen flagship 2 (ai-bookkeeper): the MCC layer on a held-out third buyer (Durham County Council procurement-card report) and importer fixes the real file exposed
errors: The first bank.mjs edit added 'gross amount' as a general amount alias, which broke the SumUp Gross/Fee/Net test (booked gross instead of net). The full suite caught it; it was narrowed to a VAT-without-fee rule.

The first version of the sign rule required pos === null; a merchant named 'U OF I ONLINE PAYMENT' matched the weak payment pattern on one real month and blocked it. Found by checking all 78 files; fixed with !pos.
The post's description was 188 characters (limit 160); the pre-push hook blocked the push. git commit --amend was refused by the auto-mode classifier, so the fix went in a separate commit.

doc_friction.issue: The Monitor tool is deferred; calling it without loading it through ToolSearch failed once. A blocking sleep-then-cat was also refused. A run_in_background until-loop was the working way to wait for long evals.
It has no --dry-run to list what --for-changes would run; I guessed the flag and it errored.

writeups: ventures/ai-bookkeeper/README.md (Merchant category codes on a third buyer: Durham County Council)
notes: Data: 78 monthly CSVs from durham.gov.uk/article/8154 (OGL v3.0), fetched at run time and not committed. Importer check on all 78 real files: 199,776/199,776 rows, cents match the Gross Amount column on every file, MCC on every line. Eval (eval/durham-pcard.mjs; layer unchanged after reading): first-seen 7,354 lines, off 53.3/34.6, table 69.4/25.2, default 87.8/11.6 right/wrong. Plurality on: identical. --field name: 97.7% (the column is the council's own label, so it leaks the answer; not used). Departments: Resources 40.2->75.1, Adult and Health 51.3->75.5, DSG 62.8->69.5, Transformation 54.3->72.8. Local tests: node --test '*.test.mjs' 'eval/*.test.mjs' in ventures/ai-bookkeeper 3081/3081 pass. venture-preflight and run_workflow_locally --for-changes: see PR.
